# quoteai

> quoteai (quoteai.ca) is quoting and job-management software for Canadian trade contractors and small service businesses. A contractor describes a job in plain words, by text or voice, and quoteai drafts a professional quote in about 30 seconds: line items, quantities, unit prices and the correct Canadian sales tax for the customer's province. The same numbers then flow into the contract, e-signature, deposit, job, invoice and payment. It works in English and French (Canada), on the web and as an Android app.

Key facts:
- Who it is for: independent tradespeople and small contracting firms in Canada (painters, electricians, plumbers, roofers, HVAC technicians, general contractors, landscapers, cleaners and more).
- Market: Canada only. Launching first in British Columbia, Ontario and Québec (the pilot provinces).
- Languages: English (en-CA) and French (fr-CA); quotes can be written in either language for the customer.
- Taxes: GST, HST, PST and QST are shown as separate lines, as the CRA and provincial ministries expect, never one blended rate.
- Payments: customers pay by Interac e-Transfer, cheque or card; card payments go to the contractor's own Stripe account.
- Trial: 7 days free, no credit card. A single quote can also be bought without a plan.
- Prices are in Canadian dollars, before tax.
- Company: quoteai, Canada. Contact: info@quoteai.ca.

## Plans

- Starter: CA$29/month, 15 AI quotes a month
- Pro: CA$79/month, 60 AI quotes a month
- Business: CA$249/month, unlimited quotes
- Elite: custom price

Annual billing charges ten months for a year. Details: [Pricing](https://quoteai.ca/pricing/).

## Free calculators

Free, no sign-up, in English and French: [all calculators](https://quoteai.ca/tools/).

- [GST, HST, PST and QST calculator for contractors](https://quoteai.ca/tools/sales-tax-calculator/): Add or remove GST, HST, PST and QST for any province, each tax on its own line.
- [Construction holdback calculator](https://quoteai.ca/tools/holdback-calculator/): The 10 % holdback on a progress bill, what is payable now, and the tax when it is released.
- [Markup vs margin calculator](https://quoteai.ca/tools/markup-margin-calculator/): Cost to price with a markup or a target margin, and why 25 % markup is only 20 % margin.
- [What should I charge per hour](https://quoteai.ca/tools/labour-rate-calculator/): The hourly rate that covers your pay, your overhead and a profit, from the hours you can really bill.

## Provinces

- [British Columbia](https://quoteai.ca/provinces/british-columbia/): sales tax on quotes and invoices shown as GST 5 % + PST 7 %.
- [Ontario](https://quoteai.ca/provinces/ontario/): sales tax on quotes and invoices shown as HST 13 %.
- [Quebec](https://quoteai.ca/provinces/quebec/): sales tax on quotes and invoices shown as GST 5 % + QST 9.975 %.

## Help centre

- [Set up your business in 10 minutes](https://quoteai.ca/help/getting-started/): Create your account, fill in the business profile that appears on every quote, contract and invoice, and pick a plan.
- [Create a quote from a description, a voice memo or photos](https://quoteai.ca/help/create-a-quote/): Describe the job in plain language and get an itemized, taxed quote in about 30 seconds. Then edit it, offer Good/Better/Best options and pick a PDF template.
- [Send a quote and get it accepted online](https://quoteai.ca/help/send-a-quote-and-get-it-accepted/): Email the quote or share its link. The customer reviews and accepts on a secure page; automatic follow-ups nudge them on days 2, 5 and 10 until they answer.
- [Contracts and e-signature](https://quoteai.ca/help/contracts-and-e-signature/): An accepted quote becomes a contract built on your province's template. The customer signs online with an email verification code; both of you get the signed PDF and its audit certificate.
- [Jobs: setup review, milestones and change orders](https://quoteai.ca/help/jobs-milestones-and-change-orders/): Every signed contract becomes a job with milestones, a schedule and a budget proposed by the AI. Confirm it in one click, track progress, and handle extras with change orders the customer signs.
- [Invoices, e-Transfer and card payments](https://quoteai.ca/help/invoices-and-getting-paid/): Deposit, progress and final invoices are generated from the contract's payment schedule. Customers pay by Interac e-Transfer or by card; reminders go out at 3, 7 and 14 days past due.
- [Track costs, scan receipts and log time](https://quoteai.ca/help/costs-receipts-and-time/): Photograph a receipt and the AI files it against the job. Workers clock in and out from a personal link — no app, no login — and the job's margin updates in real time.
- [Invite your team and set roles](https://quoteai.ca/help/team-accounts-and-roles/): Give office staff, foremen or your accountant their own login with a role that limits what they can see and do. Pro includes 2 seats, Elite 5.
- [Leads, follow-ups and review requests](https://quoteai.ca/help/leads-and-follow-ups/): Every quote request lands in the Leads pipeline — from your website widget, WhatsApp, Meta Lead Ads or Google Local Services Ads. Follow up until it is won or lost, within Canada's anti-spam rules.
- [Integrations and importing your old quotes](https://quoteai.ca/help/integrations-and-imports/): Send from your own Gmail, sync milestones to Google Calendar or Outlook, post paid invoices to QuickBooks or Wave, take card payments with Stripe, and import years of past quotes from a spreadsheet or old PDFs.
- [Delete your account and data](https://quoteai.ca/help/delete-your-account/): How to delete your QuoteAI account from the app or the website, what is erased, what the law makes us keep, and how to change your mind within 7 days.

## En français

quoteai est un logiciel de soumissions et de gestion de chantiers pour les entrepreneurs et gens de métier au Canada. Décrivez le travail en quelques mots et obtenez en 30 secondes une soumission professionnelle avec les bonnes taxes (TPS, TVH, TVP, TVQ) pour la province du client, puis le contrat, la signature, l'acompte, la facture et le paiement. Essai gratuit de 7 jours, sans carte de crédit.

- [Accueil](https://quoteai.ca/fr/)
- [Tarifs](https://quoteai.ca/fr/tarifs/)
- [Projet pilote](https://quoteai.ca/fr/pilote/)

Calculateurs gratuits ([tous](https://quoteai.ca/fr/outils/)) :
- [Calculateur de TPS, TVH, TVP et TVQ pour entrepreneurs](https://quoteai.ca/fr/outils/calculateur-taxes-de-vente/): Ajoutez ou retirez la TPS, la TVH, la TVP et la TVQ pour toute province, chaque taxe sur sa ligne.
- [Calculateur de retenue de construction](https://quoteai.ca/fr/outils/calculateur-retenue/): La retenue de 10 % sur une facture progressive, le montant payable maintenant et les taxes à la libération.
- [Calculateur majoration ou marge](https://quoteai.ca/fr/outils/calculateur-majoration-marge/): Du coût au prix avec une majoration ou une marge visée, et pourquoi 25 % de majoration ne font que 20 % de marge.
- [Combien facturer de l'heure](https://quoteai.ca/fr/outils/calculateur-taux-horaire/): Le taux horaire qui couvre votre salaire, vos frais généraux et un profit, selon vos heures vraiment facturables.
